params.name: filter[createdAt]
params.description: Used to filter events based on dates. The operator should follow the value. Operators can f.ex. be $gte for "Greater than or equal" and $lte for "Less than or equal".

params.name: filter[event]
params.description: The event to filter the audits by. Some events will not be available for 3rd party access.

params.name: filter[objectType]
params.description: The type of object to filter the audits by. Some types of objects will not be available for 3rd party access.
